title: Marksans Pharma Receives 6 USFDA Form 483 Observations at Goa Plant

contentHtml:
Mumbai: Marksans Pharma Limited has received six observations from the United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) following a Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) inspection conducted at its manufacturing facility in Verna, Goa.

The inspection was conducted between November 12 and November 20, 2026. Following the inspection, the USFDA issued Form 483 to the company, listing six observations.

According to the company's regulatory filing with the stock exchanges, all six observations are procedural in nature. The company clarified that there were no observations related to data integrity or repeated observations.

Marksans Pharma stated that it would work closely with the USFDA to address all the observations comprehensively within the stipulated timeline. The company also stated that it does not anticipate any impact on its new product pipeline or commercial supplies from the inspected facility.

The company further assured that it would keep the stock exchanges informed about any further developments in the matter.

Marksans Pharma Limited, headquartered in Mumbai, is engaged in the research, manufacturing and marketing of generic pharmaceutical formulations across global markets. Its manufacturing facilities are approved by several leading regulatory agencies, including the USFDA, UKMHRA and Australian TGA. The company's product portfolio includes medicines across cardiovascular, central nervous system, antidiabetic, pain management, gastroenterological and anti-allergic therapeutic segments.
